It is dedicated to St. Mary and is always open to all residents and passersby, because “the Mother of God is happy about every visit!”

properties.name: Heimatmuseum Dorfen (Museum of local history Dorfen)
properties.description: Das Heimatmuseum in Dorfen zeigt zahlreiche Aspekte der Ortsgeschichte, von der Steinzeit bis in die Gegenwart. Die Dorfener Wallfahrt und die ehemalige Lokalbahnlinie sind ebenso Themen wie etwa Handwerk und Wohnen in früherer Zeit. Ein eigener Bereich ist den Dorfener Autoren Josef Martin Bauer und Rudolf Kirmeyer sowie dem Heimatforscher Pfarrer Josef Gammel gewidmet.

properties.name: Museum Altomünster (Museum Altomünster)
properties.description: St. Birgitta of Sweden (1303-1373) is one of the most important women of the Middle Ages - she was a mystic, politician and fighter for peace. The order of Birgittine nuns she founded spread throughout Europe. Germany's last convent of the Birgittine order was located in Altomünster (Museum Altomünster), which is located in the immediate vicinity of the convent church and recalls the history of the convent and the life of the founder of the order.

properties.name: Pilgrimage Church of Maria Morgenstern in Lippertskirchen
properties.description:
With the curtailment of the proprietary church system in the 9th/10th century, it was transferred to the cathedral church in Freising and attached to the Freising episcopal court in Elbach. In 1315, Lippertskirchen appears as a branch of Elbach, and from 1448 as a branch of Au.

On January 28, 1349, a Freising auxiliary bishop reconsecrated a chapel dedicated to St. Leonard with a cemetery in Lippertskirchen. This chapel probably remained as a side aisle when the church was rebuilt at the beginning of the 15th century. Remains of the Gothic house of God can be recognized as a saddleback tower and in the small outer window arches.

The remodeling carried out from 1778 onward in the Baroque style according to the plans of the Munich court master builder Franz Anton Kirchgrabner is rooted in the veneration of Mary documented in Lippertskirchen since the 14th century, which is attested as a pilgrimage to "Maria Morgenstern."

The Rococo furnishings made between 1783 and 1785 by the sculptor Joseph Götsch, centered on the late Gothic Queen of Heaven "Maria Morgenstern," and the attractive ceiling frescoes created in 1798 by the Munich painter Joseph Hauber are an example of the adaptation of courtly style in a rural setting. They, like the stucco decorations made by Franz Doll from Wessobrunn, which in their motifs still remain tied to Rococo, also point to the emerging Classicism.

Every year on November 6, the Leonhardi Ride takes place in Lippertskirchen. In the threefold circuit, the faithful implore the protection and blessing of St. Leonard, patron saint of livestock, for house and stable.

After the separation from Elbach, the branch church was pastorally cared for on a weekly alternating basis with Litzldorf by a benefice holder from Au. In 1922, the Lippertskirchen-Wiechs expositure was established; the expositus Alfons Amrain served as curate from 1958. This expositure was elevated to the Parish of the Sacred Heart in Feilnbach in 1963.



### The Way of St. James

The world-famous pilgrimage route, the Way of St. James, passes the church. Here you will find a description of the stage:

[Way of St. James Stage 17 – From Au near Bad Aibling along old mule tracks into the Inn Valley >>](https://www.chiemsee-alpenland.de/entdecken/tourenportal/jakobsweg-etappe-17-von-au-bei-bad-aibling-auf-alten-saumpfaden-ins-inntal-d0112e9865)

[More information on the Way of St. James >>](https://www.chiemsee-alpenland.de/entdecken/tourenportal/jakobsweg-etappe-17-von-au-bei-bad-aibling-auf-alten-saumpfaden-ins-inntal-d0112e9865)



### Opening hours and guided tours

The church is always open during the day. Guided church tours can be arranged in consultation with the parish office.

properties.name: Branch Church "St. Laurentius" Viehbach
properties.description: The bright and welcoming "St. Laurentius" Church blends perfectly into the village scene of Viehbach. Located in the north of the small village, the church, surrounded by farms and fields, is a typical landmark in the west of the Freising district.

properties.name: German Museum Flugwerft Schleißheim
properties.description: At the Flugwerft Schleißheim, more than 70 aircraft can be admired in two halls – from modern fighter jets to historic wooden airplanes, there is something for young and old alike. You should also not miss the glass workshop!

properties.name: Parish Church of St. Nicholas in Albaching
properties.description:
Among the most remarkable, and at the same time latest, church buildings in the Wasserburg area is St. Nicholas Church, whose furnishings belong to the early Classicist period (1790). The original Gothic chancel was expanded in 1790 by Mathias Rösler and Matthias Egger with a new nave. Originally there was a tower on the south side, but it was destroyed by lightning in 1798 and replaced between 1811 and 1812 by a new building by Gustav Vorherr on the west side of the church. From 1995 to 1998, the interior of the church was renovated, restoring its Classicist appearance.

The frescoes in the interior were created by the court painter Christian Wink. Particularly noteworthy is the dome fresco above the nave with St. Nicholas as intercessor. The frescoes are signed "Christ Wink pictor aulicus Monnachii pinxit 1791 et 1792". Wink's cousin Johann Adam also contributed.

The high altar was made in 1796 by Franz Xaver Brand, with the altarpiece of the Crucifixion of Christ by Christian Wink and the side figures of Saints Peter and Nicholas by Johann Chrysostomus Geisenhofer. The side altars date from 1814. On the southern altar is the painting "Joseph's Death" by Ignaz Alois Frey, who also painted the Stations of the Cross in 1820.

properties.name: St. Sebastiani Church
properties.description:
The former St. Sebastian Chapel was built in 1548 in honor of St. Sebastian, the saint invoked against the plague. The church is documented only from 1603 onward. In Aibling's church history, St. Sebastian is a highly revered martyr who was greatly venerated in the form of processions during the plague years (1634–1641).

Following the great city fire of 1765, the original church was destroyed. Through the combined efforts of the townspeople, the church was rebuilt and decorated with special details inside. These include, for example, the Sebastian altar created by Aibling woodcarver Joseph Götsch, or the ceiling painting illustrating the Passion of Saint Sebastian. Particularly worthy of note are the name plaques of the Aibling citizen families, who still preserve "their" church pews to this day. As patron saint of the marksmen, a solemn Mass is celebrated every year on Sebastian's Day by the mountain riflemen.

**Opening hours:**

Daily from approx. 08:00 to 17:00

properties.name: Branch Church "St. Stephanus" Lauterbach
properties.description: It almost seems as if the little Church of St. Stephen wants to hide from its visitors. However, its location far from the main road on the outskirts of Lauterbach, among large old trees, makes it something very special.

properties.name: Taxa Chapel
properties.description:
About 800 meters downstream along the Aubach stands Taxa Chapel. Although it has the name chapel, it is in fact a church, indeed even a pilgrimage church. It originated from a vow made by the Auer brown weaver Balthasar Fuetterer in 1647 during a pilgrimage to Weihenlinden. He built a wooden chapel, which was replaced by a stone building just a few years later. The name Taxa comes from the Bavarian word “Daxn,” the term for spruce and fir branches. Several coniferous trees once stood around the little church.

As the pilgrimage to the miraculous image “Mary’s Visitation” (Mary, while pregnant, visits her cousin Elizabeth, who is soon expecting a child) grew greatly in popularity, the little church was enlarged in 1748 by Philipp Millauer of Hausstatt and furnished as a Baroque chapel. The altarpiece shows the encounter between the two women. Fine wood carvings can be seen, depicting saints in local dress. A ceiling painting is also interesting because it shows the inhabitants of Au in festive clothing around 1750. In the Age of Enlightenment, only a few decades later, the church was declared structurally unsound. But the resistance of the local population and of the parish priest Gregor von Gietl (1773–1785) prevented the demolition of the Baroque gem. The little church was finally saved in 1809, when the community of Au acquired the house of worship for 175 gulden and 47 kreuzer.

The patronal feast is celebrated on July 2, the feast of the Visitation of Mary.

properties.name: Heimatstube der Hodschager und Donauschwaben
properties.description: The Moosburg "Haus der Heimat" (House of the homeland) houses six groups of displaced persons from the Batschka, Silesia and the Sudetenland. The Hodschager Heimatstube displays rich collections of original costumes, textiles and agricultural and domestic utensils from the Batschka. In addition, numerous exhibits from the town of Königsberg a. d. Eger and from other areas of the Sudetenland are on display.

properties.name: Parish Church "St. Hildegard" Munich
properties.description: Right on Munich's Paosostraße, in the heart of the Pasing district, lies the parish center of the parish of "St. Hildegard," at the center of which the modern parish church of the same name makes an architectural and artistic statement.

properties.name: Pfaffenhofen Art Museum
properties.description: Since 2009, the Pfaffenhofen Art Hall has served as a venue for contemporary art and photography by regional and national artists from spring through fall. The hall is operated by the Neue Pfaffenhofener Kunstverein, founded in 2007. With a floor area of just over 800 square meters and a ceiling height of nearly 15 meters, the former machine hall is a sight to behold in its own right. The exhibition openings and closing events are popular attractions and highlights of social gatherings. Particular attention was drawn, for example, to the group exhibitions featuring artists from Barcelona and the academy class from Braunschweig, the retrospective of the religious painter Michael P. Weingartner—whose reputation extends beyond Pfaffenhofen—as well as the solo exhibition by Markus Lüpertz accompanied by a jazz band. Current exhibitions can be found on the website.

properties.name: Escape the City Munich – The Unsolved Crime
properties.description:
In “The Unsolved Crime,” Munich becomes an outdoor escape room. The team reconstructs a mysterious murder case, piecing together clues found on-site and working together to solve the challenges along the route.

Unlike purely digital outdoor games, this experience includes a real game kit: After placing your order, the case file and evidence materials are mailed to your home. All you need is a smartphone; no app is required. Once the package arrives, you can choose your own game day and start time.

The adventure is designed for 2 to 8 people and lasts about 2 to 3.5 hours. Shipping within Germany is included in the team price of 79.90 euros and usually takes 4 to 5 business days. The starting point is the Neptune Fountain in the old botanical garden. The exact route remains part of the game.

properties.name: Kulturwerkstatt Haus 10
properties.description: The Kulturwerkstatt Haus 10 offers art lovers the opportunity to explore the building's diverse workshops in addition to changing exhibitions of current art trends. The former monastery grounds with their clear structures and shapes create an ideal space for introspection and artistic creativity. The combination of the three workshops for sculpture, printing and painting with the art gallery opens up new approaches and creative processes. This is reflected in the regularly changing exhibitions, which cover the entire range of artistic media.

properties.name: Filialkirche „Mariä Himmelfahrt” Inhausen
properties.description: There, where the northern foothills of the Munich gravel plain meet the Tertiary hill country of the southwestern Dachau region, the Church of the Assumption of Mary stands clearly visible from afar in the middle of the small village of Inhausen.

properties.name: Parish Church “St. Michael” Giebing
properties.description: Die mächtige Pfarrkirche „St. Michael“ liegt am Ortsrand des Dorfes Giebing mit freiem Blick über die typischen Felder und Wäldchen des Dachauer Landes. In ihrem Inneren offenbart sich ihren Besuchern ein außergewöhnlicher Kirchenraum.

properties.name: KZ-Gedenkstätte Dachau (Dachau Concentration Camp Memorial Site)
properties.description: On 22 March 1933, a concentration camp for political prisoners was established in Dachau. It served as a model for all later concentration camps and as a "school of violence" for the men of the SS. In the 12 years of its existence, over 200,000 people from all over Europe were imprisoned here and in 140 subcamps. 41,500 were murdered. The KZ-Gedenkstätte Dachau (Dachau Concentration Camp Memorial Site) was built in 1965 on the initiative of and according to the plans of surviving prisoners and comprises the grounds of the former prisoners' camp and the crematorium area. The Jourhaus with the entrance and the gate inscription "Arbeit macht frei" ("Work makes you free"), the utility building, the camp prison ("bunker"), watchtowers and crematoria have been preserved. At the transition from the former roll call square to the camp road with its original 34 prisoner barracks are two reconstructed buildings, one of which is accessible as a museum barrack. The service building now houses a permanent exhibition on the historical site. The focus is on the fate of the inmates, under the leitmotif "The Path of the Prisoners". In addition, four religious memorial sites (Jewish, Catholic, Protestant and Russian Orthodox) and a central memorial on the former roll call square were created.As further memorial sites, the former SS shooting range Hebertshausen, where over 4000 Soviet prisoners of war were murdered, the concentration camp cemetery on the Leitenberg and the forest cemetery can be visited in the vicinity.

properties.name: Museum "Haus der Donauschwaben" (Museum "House of the Danube Swabians)
properties.description: The history of the Danube Swabians from their settlement in the 18th century to their flight and expulsion in the 20th century can be traced in the House of the Danube Swabians with exhibits of daily life and economic activity.

properties.name: Branch Church "Quirin and St. Leonhard" in Großeisenbach
properties.description: Set away from the main road, the late Romanesque church, later baroqueized, "St. Quirinus and St. Leonhard" stands on a picturesque rise above the small village of Großeisenbach in the Freising district.

properties.name: St. Bartholomäus Church in Kleinhöhenrain
properties.description:
Beautifully situated with views of the expansive Mangfall Valley and 80 mountain peaks! Before St. Bartholomäus Church was built on the site, it is said that Höhenrain Castle stood there in the 10th century.
The church walls still date from the Romanesque period. In the 15th century, the church was remodeled in the Gothic style and then given a Baroque makeover from 1720 onward. Particularly valuable is the pulpit with symbols of the Evangelists, which was made in 1784 by the woodcarver Josef Götsch from Bad Aibling. The church is located directly next to the ["Zur schönen Aussicht" inn](https://www.chiemsee-alpenland.de/Media/Gastronomie/Alm-Berggasthof-Feldkirchen-Westerham-LandGutHotel-Gasthof-Zur-schoenen-Aussicht). A Way of the Cross, also called the [Trail of the Senses](https://www.chiemsee-alpenland.de/Media/touren-gps/Auf-dem-Wanderweg-der-Sinne), also leads to St. Bartholomäus Church.

Source:
Helmut Giese: Bruckmühl und Umgebung - Ein Heimatbuch. Bruckmühl, 2006

properties.name: Escape the City Munich – The Missing Opera Singer
properties.description:
Bei „Die vermisste Opernsängerin“ wird München zum Outdoor Escape Room. Kurz vor ihrem großen Auftritt verschwindet die berühmte Sängerin Amélie Bonnet spurlos. Das Team folgt ihren Spuren und löst die Rätsel entlang der Route.

Anders als bei rein digitalen Outdoor-Spielen gehört hier ein echtes Spielpaket zum Erlebnis: Nach der Bestellung kommen Fallakte und Beweismaterialien per Post nach Hause. Zusätzlich wird nur ein Smartphone benötigt; eine App ist nicht erforderlich. Sobald das Paket angekommen ist, lassen sich Spieltag und Startzeit frei wählen.

Das Abenteuer ist für 2 bis 8 Personen ausgelegt und dauert etwa 2 bis 3,5 Stunden. Der Versand innerhalb Deutschlands ist im Team-Preis von 79,90 Euro enthalten und dauert in der Regel 4 bis 5 Werktage. Startpunkt ist Denkmal für Maximilian I. Joseph / Bayrische Staatsoper, Max-Joseph-Platz, 80539 München. Die genaue Route bleibt Teil des Spiels.

properties.name: Parish Church of the Assumption of Mary, Vagen
properties.description: This beautiful church was first mentioned in 1315 in the "Conradin Register" as a branch church of Götting. It was a curacy church until 1875 and has been a parish church since 1958. The present Baroque church has had its current appearance since the mid-18th century. A votive painting on the east side commemorates this. Noteworthy in the nave are the cross with Pietà, the Mercy Seat, St. Rasso, St. Valentine, and opposite the entrance the Madonna with Child.

properties.name: Museum Nymphenburg Porcelain
properties.description: A collection of Nymphenburg porcelain unique in the world is on display in Nymphenburg Palace, Munich.

properties.name: Heimatmuseum Glonn (Museum of local history Glonn)
properties.description: The Heimatmuseum Glonn (Museum of local history Glonn) mainly displays objects from rural Bavarian life and work. Exhibits from the possessions and work of Glonn personalities such as the writer Lena Christ, the surgeon Prof. Dr. Max Lebsché, the composer Prof. Günter Bialas, the painter Georg Lanzenberger and the local writer Hans Ernst are particularly worthy of mention. An operational ropemaking workshop and a shoemaker's workshop convey the craftsmanship of bygone times.

properties.name: Schafhof - Europäisches Künstlerhaus Oberbayern (Schafhof - European House of Artists Upper Bavaria)
properties.description: The Schafhof in Freising offers a unique exhibition context: situated on a hill and surrounded by nature and trees, the massive building complex impresses with its history and architecture. Originally used as a sheepfold, the Schafhof now serves as a European artists' centre for the district of Upper Bavaria. A wide variety of artistic expressions of European and regional culture are presented here. The impressive barrel vault on the upper floor creates a special atmosphere and impressively showcases contemporary works.

properties.name: Kath. Stadtpfarrkirche Mariä Himmelfahrt
properties.description:
Towering powerfully above Kirchgasse is the Catholic parish church of the Assumption of Mary, rebuilt after the fire of 1783 by Johan Baumgartner. As we know from descriptions, the Miesbach church was a major work of the Baroque Miesbach stucco sculptors’ school (after the Wessobrunn school, the best-known stucco sculptors’ school in Old Bavaria) and the important Miesbach woodcarving tradition from the Late Gothic to the Rococo. Nothing remained after the fire except the masonry core of the choir, the buttresses, and the base of the tower. The church was erected as a simple hall church from 1783 to 1786.

Characteristic of the exterior are the elegant early Neoclassical tower top and the pleasing broken choir roof. The rich Neo-Romanesque decoration of the church, in which the self-image of Miesbach’s prosperous bourgeoisie of the 19th century was manifested (as in the town hall), was removed in 1936/37 and then completely in 1962/63. The interior appears bare, and therefore renovation is also planned in the near future.

Preserved is the pilgrimage figure of the "Mater Dolorosa," rescued from the flames and carved in 1665 by Johann Millauer, which in 1963 was inserted into the then newly assembled crucifixion group with two side figures, hanging freely in the choir. The body of Christ was carved by Roman Anton Boos before 1783. This imposing crucifixion group is the focal point of the church interior.

properties.name: St. Michael's Fountain
properties.description:
Der Arzt Michael Gschwändler hat mit den ersten Versuchen die

Heilwirkung des Moors nachgewiesen und versorgte als Landarzt damals das gesamte Gebiet des Altlandkreises. Dieser verdiente Bürger Bad Aiblings hat mit seiner Forschung die medizinischen und wissenschaftlichen Grundlagen für das Heilbad gelegt. Als Andenken an den "Moor-Pionier" Michael Gschwändler wurde der St. Michaels Brunnen von seinen Söhnen errichtet.

properties.name: Museum Penzberg – Sammlung Campendonk
properties.description: The expressionist painter Heinrich Campendonk (1889-1957) is at the centre of the Museum Penzberg. He came to Bavaria from the Rhineland in 1911 and became the youngest member of the artist group "Der Blaue Reiter" (The Blue Rider). In order to be able to exhibit even more works from the extensive Campendonk collection, the museum building was extended in 2016.Pitch coal was mined in Penzberg over a period of 170 years, until 1966. The listed old building of the museum was built in 1873 as a workers' dwelling. This type of house shaped the appearance of the town as a "colony". One of the former six flats in the house was furnished with contemporary furniture and household effects from around 1920.Another room is dedicated to the memory of the "Penzberg Murder Night" in 1945.

properties.name: Hiasl Monument in Kissing
properties.description: The small Hiasl monument honoring Matthäus Klostermayr, who was born in Kissing in 1736, stands in front of the Old School in his hometown on Bachernstraße. It depicts the poacher and bandit leader with his rifle and his feared dog, Tyras. The “Bavarian Hiasl” was revered by the farmers as a social rebel because he hunted the game cherished by the nobility and the Kissing Jesuits, which ravaged their fields. After his gruesome execution—the man from Kissing was broken on the wheel and quartered in Dillingen in 1771 before a huge crowd—"Hiasl" was celebrated in song as a folk hero.

properties.name: Unteraigen Leisure Stable
properties.description:
Der Pferdehof von Veronika ist ein Ort, an dem Pferde artgerecht leben und Reiter ihre Leidenschaft in harmonischer Atmosphäre ausleben können. Hier stehen das Wohl der Tiere, eine respektvolle Mensch-Pferd-Beziehung und eine fachkundige Ausbildung im Mittelpunkt.

Die Pferde genießen großzügige Außenboxen mit Gummimatten und beheizbaren Tränkebecken oder den Offenstall mit direktem Zugang zu weitläufigen Weiden. Wälzplätze, eine Todholzecke und Holundergebüsch bieten zusätzlichen Komfort und natürliche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten. Dank abgestimmter Herdenhaltung und täglichem Weidegang fühlen sich die Pferde rundum wohl.

Reiter finden hier nicht nur eine pferdegerechte Haltung, sondern auch eine fundierte Ausbildung. Veronika, ausgebildete Geländerittführerin und anerkannte Übungsleiterin der VFD, vermittelt ihr umfangreiches Wissen über Pferdehaltung, Reiten und harmonische Partnerschaft zwischen Mensch und Tier. Individuelle Reitkurse und geführte Ausritte sorgen für unvergessliche Erlebnisse.

Ein gemütliches Stüberl lädt zum Austausch unter Gleichgesinnten ein, während Futter- und Reitsportbedarf bequem bis zur Sattelkammer geliefert wird. Ob ambitionierte Reiter oder Pferdeliebhaber – hier werden Träume wahr. Der Pferdehof verbindet Leidenschaft, Fachwissen und Fürsorge und schafft so ein echtes Paradies für Pferde und Menschen.

properties.name: Catholic parish church "St. Anton"
properties.description:
Die Pfarrkirche St. Anton in Hausham wurde 1905 im neubarocken Stil errichtet und bildet das religiöse Zentrum der Gemeinde. Der helle Innenraum ist schlicht und harmonisch gestaltet, ergänzt durch einige kunstvolle Elemente aus der Erbauungszeit.

Regelmäßige Gottesdienste:

Mittwoch: 19.00 Uhr - Eucharistiefeier

Samstag: 19.00 Uhr - Eucharistiefeier

Sonntag: 09.00 Uhr - Eucharistiefeier (kroatische Gemeinde), 10.30 Uhr - Eucharistiefeier

properties.name: Heimat- und Torfmuseum Gröbenzell (Museum of local history and peat Gröbenzell)
properties.description: Das Museum führt den Besucher in die Lebensumstände der Bevölkerung um die Gründungszeit der Siedlung ein. Besonderes Augenmerk haben die Gestalter des Museums auf die Torfgewinnung in den Mooren um Gröbenzell gerichtet. Anschaulich gestaltete Schautafeln und Dioramen zeigen die geologische Entwicklung des Moores, wie es für die Dachauer Gegend typisch ist.

properties.name: Rapperzell Moated Castle
properties.description: Das ehemalige Wasserschlösschen Rapperzell wird zwar privat bewohnt. Doch vor dem hübschen Barockbau informiert eine Beschilderung darüber, dass er ab 1838 ein Jagdschloss des Herzogs Maximilian in Bayern war. Dieser Wittelsbacher war der Vater der Kaiserin von Österreich und Königin Ungarns – Elisabeth, genannt „Sisi“.

properties.name: Irschenberg Equestrian Center
properties.description:
The equestrian center at Irschenberg is nestled in the picturesque hilly landscape of the foothills of the Alps and offers horse enthusiasts a unique combination of first-class training facilities and idyllic nature. The modern facility features spacious stables, bright riding arenas, and well-maintained outdoor arenas that are ideally suited for both leisure riders and competition riders. A vast hacking area with well-marked trails invites you to enjoy long rides with breathtaking views of the Alps.

The facility places particular emphasis on professional care for horse and rider. Experienced trainers are available for private and group lessons, while the dedicated team takes care of the horses’ well-being. The equestrian center also offers boarding for guest horses, with individually tailored feeding and care plans.

Its location, just a few minutes from the A8 motorway, makes the equestrian center easy to reach. Parking spaces for horse transporters are sufficiently available. The surrounding area also offers plenty for accompanying persons: from walks in nature to visits to nearby cafés or sights, there is something for everyone.

The equestrian center at Irschenberg is not only a place for sporting activities, but also a place of relaxation where people and animals are equally welcome.

properties.name: Branch Church "St. Johannes Baptist" Hörenzhausen
properties.description: Crossing the beautiful courtyard of the Modlmayr family, you eventually reach, via a steep staircase, the charming old Romanesque church of "St. Johannes Baptist," which watches over the small village of Hörenzhausen from a sunny south-facing slope.

properties.name: Apocalypse Museum
properties.description:
In the Sulzbach district near Aichach is the “Apocalypse Museum” in a historic farmhouse. Two impressive cycles by the late artist Adolf Ziegler from Friedberg are on display there.

The museum presents a total of 128 large-format panels that engage intensively with the Book of Revelation. These consist of 64 silver oxide reliefs and 64 richly colored stained-glass panels, which are being made accessible to the public in their entirety for the first time.

Guided tours are available year-round by prior arrangement for those interested.

properties.name: Ried Forest Nature Trail
properties.description: Mit Hilfe des Walderlebnispfades zum Thema "Wald im Klimawandel" werden die Ergebnisse der Waldklima-Forschung für die Bevölkerung insgesamt sichtbarer gemacht. Außerdem gewährt der Pfad vielfältige Einblicke in den Wald, der derzeit oft nur als Kulisse für die Freizeitgestaltung wahrgenommen wird. Ein Maskottchen, der Frischling Fridolin, führt Waldbesucherinnen und -besucher auf dem 2,5 km langen Erlebnispfad.

properties.name: Apothekarium Neubiberg
properties.description: The Apothekarium is a pharmacy museum in the south-east of Munich and invites you on a fascinating journey through the history of pharmacy. In a combined residential and commercial building dating back to 1950, historical vessels made of wood, glass and porcelain, antique tools made of bronze and brass as well as exotic artefacts from past pharmacies and cabinets of curiosities are on display. It offers insights into the development of pharmacy culture, from practical everyday objects to ornate furniture and decorative pieces.

properties.name: "Johann Nepomuk" Chapel, Pasing
properties.description: Die Johann-Nepomuk-Kapelle an der Pasinger Würmbrücke in einer kleinen Grünanlage, zeigt stellvertretend die große Verehrung des Brückenheiligen in Bayern. 1700 vom Grafen von Berchem errichtet, wurde die Kapelle im Zweiten Weltkrieg zerstört und erst 1963 im alten Zustand wiederhergestellt und eingeweiht.

properties.name: Adventure Mini-Golf at the Climbing Park
properties.description: This state-of-the-art facility, featuring a total of 18 courses, offers guests a unique mini-golf experience. A new challenge awaits on every hole—whether it’s the Loch Ness Monster, a log slalom, or a giant spiral, there’s something for everyone. The holes are located right on the edge of the forest at the Upper Bavaria Forest Climbing Park, with a beautiful view of Jetzendorf. A variety of club sizes are available, so even the youngest visitors can demonstrate their skill and feel for the ball on the course. The mini-golf course’s hours of operation are the same as those of the climbing park.

properties.name: Gerolsbach Golf Park
properties.description: Located on the edge of the Hallertau region, this 18-hole course features the typical landscape of hop-growing country and a magnificent panorama overlooking the vast mountain ranges. The ever-changing vistas of fields, forests, and isolated farmsteads, along with the topographically varied terrain featuring numerous hills and valleys, provide the setting for the challenging Gerolsbach Golf Course. The clubhouse, housed in an old barn and stable building dating from 1895, features the “Stegerhof” restaurant and a beautifully situated sun terrace. Non-golfers are also warmly welcome here.

properties.name: Heimathaus Neuchl-Anwesen (Neuchl homestead)
properties.description: In the "Neuchl-Anwesen", a small farmhouse dating from 1829, the original room functions with parlour, kitchen, dining room, etc. on the ground floor were restored and the upper floor was reserved for other exhibition areas such as folk piety, traditional costume parts and school objects.

properties.name: Escape the City Munich – The Golden Medal
properties.description:
Bei „Der Goldene Orden“ wird München zum Outdoor Escape Room. Das Team folgt den Spuren eines geheimnisvollen Ordens, kombiniert Hinweise vor Ort und löst die Prüfungen entlang der Route.

Anders als bei rein digitalen Outdoor-Spielen gehört hier ein echtes Spielpaket zum Erlebnis: Nach der Bestellung kommen Fallakte und Beweismaterialien per Post nach Hause. Zusätzlich wird nur ein Smartphone benötigt; eine App ist nicht erforderlich. Sobald das Paket angekommen ist, lassen sich Spieltag und Startzeit frei wählen.

Das Abenteuer ist für 2 bis 8 Personen ausgelegt und dauert etwa 2 bis 3,5 Stunden. Der Versand innerhalb Deutschlands ist im Team-Preis von 79,90 Euro enthalten und dauert in der Regel 4 bis 5 Werktage. Startpunkt ist Praterwehrbrücke, 80538 München. Die genaue Route bleibt Teil des Spiels.

properties.name: Parish Church of the Assumption of Mary, Weilheim
properties.description: In der Mitte Weilheims liegt am Marienplatz die Stadtpfarrkirche Mariae Himmelfahrt, die zu den größten Baudenkmälern des mit sakralen Bauten so reich gesegneten Pfaffenwinkels gehört.

properties.name: Nähmaschinenmuseum (Sewing machine museum)
properties.description: 380 sewing machines from 140 years: The museum in the monastery laundry in St Ottilien invites you on a journey through the history of the sewing machine. Numerous rarities from all over the world can be marvelled at, such as one of the first functioning models from 1866, the first electric sewing machine from 1924, a designer machine from 1957 and a series of children's and doll sewing machines.

properties.name: Urzeitmuseum - Sammlung Kapustin (Prehistoric Museum - Kapustin Collection)
properties.description: The Urzeitmuseum - Sammlung Kapustin (Prehistoric Museum - Kapustin Collection) has set itself the task of presenting the latest scientific findings in an attractive way. The exhibits range from dinosaurs and 47.5 million year old horses the size of cats to the giants of the Ice Age and the first human civilisations. Original fossils are complemented by replicas and models. Predatory dinosaurs, mammoth skulls, meteorites - there should be something for everyone!

properties.name: Maxlrain Castle
properties.description:
Just outside Bad Aibling in the Upper Bavarian foothills of the Alps and only about 60 km south of Munich lies the small village of Maxlrain. The Alpine backdrop with the Wendelstein forms the setting for the expansive grounds of Maxlrain Renaissance Palace, the landmark of a unique ensemble. Since the palace is privately owned, it cannot be visited from the inside. Wonderful hiking and cycling trails, what is probably Germany’s most beautiful golf club, [the Golf Club Schloss Maxlrain](https://www.chiemsee-alpenland.de/entdecken/alle-sehenswuerdigkeiten/golfclub-schloss-maxlrain-e.v.-d1a4de0835), and of course the culinary delights in the cozy beer gardens of the palace inn and the Bräustüberl make every visitor’s excursion an experience.



### History

Documented records show that the knights Podalunc and Reginhart built and placed their property under the protection of Freising Cathedral in **804**, in order to incorporate it as a fief of the bishop into the imperial order. The Maxlrain family reached their greatest flourishing in the 15th century and ruled as Imperial Counts of Maxlrain and Hohenwaldeck as far as Miesbach and Schliersee. In the old tournament books, this old Bavarian name can still be found.

In **1580** the castle fell victim to a great fire; only the chapel remained standing and formed the core of the new palace, which was rebuilt in eight years. It again had a tall "Gothic" roof, but now was bordered on all four sides by onion domes. In the 1720s, the famous Wessobrunn master Johann Baptist Zimmermann adorned the chapel and various salons in the palace with his light Rococo stucco work and frescoes.

The Imperial Counts of Maxlrain died out in **1734**; the last count, Johann Joseph Veit von Maxlrain, died as Prince-Bishop at Chiemsee. His daughter married a Count of Satzenhofen, whose daughter married a Count Lamberg. From this period, boundary stones with the family’s initials can still be found in the Maxlrain forest.

Around **1730**, the countess obtained permission from Elector Max Joseph III to brew brown beer by proving that the right to brew brown beer had already been exercised in Maxlrain for more than 100 years.

Finally, in **1870**, the famous eagle hunter Max Count of Arco-Zinneberg acquired Maxlrain for his son Ludwig, who added the east wing with his first wife, Countess Schaesberg, and the west wing with his second wife, Princess Lobkowicz from Bohemia, and also built the brewery anew at its present location.

In **1936**, Leo Count of Hohenthal and Bergen acquired Maxlrain. Despite his abilities, life dealt him great hardship, as his first son Adolf and his second son Wilhelm fell victim to the Second World War; his youngest son Peter died in 1970 during safety training at the Nürburgring.

In **1986**, they were able to celebrate the **350th anniversary of the brewery** with great joy; true to the motto "small and fine," it offers excellent, fresh beer specialties in its immediate surroundings. Even today, this modesty holds the secret of the high quality of all Maxlrain beer specialties.

[Events at the palace: Maxlrain Cultural Summer >>](https://www.chiemsee-alpenland.de/entdecken/veranstaltungen-brauchtum/veranstaltungs-highlights/maxlrainer-kultursommer)

[More about the Maxlrain knight games >>](https://www.chiemsee-alpenland.de/entdecken/veranstaltungen-brauchtum/veranstaltungs-highlights/maxlrainer-ritterspiele)

[Dining: Bräustüberl Maxlrain >>](https://www.chiemsee-alpenland.de/entdecken/essen-trinken/gastronomie/braeustueberl-maxlrain-04add52ac7)

[More information about Schlossbrauerei Maxlrain >>](https://www.chiemsee-alpenland.de/entdecken/alle-sehenswuerdigkeiten/schlossbrauerei-maxlrain-6b911a2ab7)

properties.name: Church of Mary Help in Esterndorf
properties.description:
The Church in Esterndorf, first mentioned in 1102, is a late Gothic building with impressive details such as a Baroque interior dating from 1735 and stucco work by Th. Glasl.

Originally dedicated to John the Baptist, it has been dedicated to Mary Help of Christians since 1524 and houses a Madonna by Erasmus Grasser (1505).

The tuff stone tower with a Romanesque core and wooden shingle roof, as well as the colorful facade design, make it a worthwhile destination in Weyarn.

properties.name: Villa Rustica Leutstetten
properties.description: Im heutigen Leutstetten befand sich im 2. Jh. n. Chr. ein römischer Gutshof (villa rustica). Die ergrabenen archäologischen Befunde – etwa eine gut erhaltene Fußbodenheizung – sind in einem schützenden Glaspavillion zu besichtigen. Der Grundriss des Hauptgebäudes ist im Gelände markiert. Gefäße, die mindestens 200 Jahre älter sind als die römische Villa und als zugehörige Funde ebenfalls präsentiert werden, lassen auf eine frühere keltische Siedlung schließen.

properties.name: Pilgrimage Church of the Presentation of Mary in Oberreit
properties.description:
The church was built in the 15th century, but it was remodeled in the Baroque style two hundred years later. Above all, the church tower was topped with a dome. The holy water font dates from the time of its construction and is decorated with the year 1477 and the coat of arms of the then castle owner of Altenburg, Wilhelm von Maxlrain.

In former times, many pilgrims and worshippers came to the church. The heyday of the local pilgrimage was during the grim era of the Thirty Years' War from 1618 to 1648. The altar also dates from this period. However, the miraculous image on the altar is much older still, a late Gothic carved work of art. Only the sacristy was created in the 19th century.

Other ornaments of the church are the stucco decorations, which are meant to symbolize the church's prosperity and divine protection over the souls.

properties.name: Hausham Viewpoint
properties.description: Huberspitz, Gindelalmen and Huabaoim are popular hiking destinations from Hausham. However, the Hausham viewpoint with the small shelter and view over the old mining village with its headframe is more of an insider tip on this route and promises a relaxing rest. The ascent via the serpentine path toward Huberspitz takes about 30 minutes.

properties.name: Golfclub Mangfalltal e.V.
properties.description:
Arrive. Feel at home. Play golf. It’s not just the breathtaking views of the Bavarian Alps that make you forget everyday life for a few hours. Mangfalltal Golf Course demands your full concentration and attention. The rather flat front nine is the ideal warm-up before you head from the tee at Almhütte on hole 10 into the hilly back nine. The clubhouse of Golf- und Landclub Mangfalltal, a lovingly renovated manor house dating from 1833, serves Mediterranean delicacies with a dreamlike view of the Alps.


### Information about the golf course

- Length, men: 5,748 m (CR/SL: 70.9/132)  
Length, women: 5,142 m (CR/SL: 73.4/125)
- Par: 72 · Number of holes: 18, standard handicap: Mon.-Fri.: min. -54, weekends/public holidays: min. -36
- 18-hole
- Practice facilities
- 9-hole rate available
- Guests welcome!
- Registration requested
- Golf school
- Golf shop
- Restaurant
- Rental clubs
- Rental trolleys
- Carts


#### Blooming Golf Course


In 2021, Golfclub Mangfalltal received the state seal "Blooming Golf Course" from the Bavarian Ministry of the Environment. Certain criteria must be met for this, and they were successfully fulfilled. The golf course has 60% pure nature, a true eldorado for various insects. The unmown areas also provide a place for overwintering in winter.

properties.name: Märchenwald im Isartal
properties.description: Fairy Tale Forest in the Isar Valley

properties.name: Heimatmuseum Isen
properties.description: The old city hall (Altes city hall) of Markt Isen is a listed building and houses exhibits on the history of Isen and the surrounding area, including agriculture, trade, crafts, guilds and associations.

properties.name: Naherholungsgebiet Höglinger Seen
properties.description:
Höglinger Pond is a former gravel extraction site; water shoes are recommended. The sunbathing lawn is attractively landscaped with seating blocks and barbecue areas.

Admission is free, and there is ample parking available. Access to the shore is shallow, and the shoreline drops off quickly and steeply.

#### Facilities and services

- Sunbathing lawn, little shade
- Lifeguards / swimming supervision on weekends
- Parking
- Dogs allowed
- Playground (climbing tower, slide, sandbox)
- Barbecue areas

#### Accessible

- Barrier-free access possible

properties.name: Hutter-Heimatmuseum (Hutter Home Museum)
properties.description: The Hutter Home Museum (Hutter-Heimatmuseum) has a triad of treasures to offer: With "Gold Treasure", "Soil Treasure" and "Home Treasure", the house named after the shoemaker Simon Hutter (1867-1957) presents the most striking themes of the region. The focus is on the history of the discovery of the Celtic gold treasure from Gaggers in 1751. The rich clay deposits and the local history of the municipality of Erdweg are presented in the other thematic rooms.

properties.name: Neues Schloss Schleißheim (New Schleißheim Castle)
properties.description: To the east of the Old Schleißheim Castle, the Neues Schloss Schleißheim (New Schleißheim Castle) was commissioned by Elector Max Emanuel and built from 1701 under the direction of Henrico Zuccalli and continued in 1715 under Joseph Effner. The New Palace was originally planned with several wings, but only the monumental main wing was realised. Effner was also responsible for the extremely important artistic decoration of the halls and state rooms. The undivided fresco by Jacopo Amigoni, which fills the entire ceiling of the Great Hall, was the largest ceiling painting in the world for several decades. Other frescoes are by Cosmas Damian Asam and Thomas Christian Wink, the carved and stuccoed interior decorations by Johann Baptist Zimmermann and Charles Dubut, among others.In front of the garden façade of the palace, a park laid out by Dominique Girard according to the principles of French garden art with a canal system extends to the Lustheim hunting lodge about 1 km away, built by Zuccalli between 1684 and 1690.

properties.name: Altes Schloss Schleißheim (Old Schleißheim Castle)
properties.description: Schleißheim Palace was founded by Duke Wilhelm V, who began building an estate as a princely Eremitage (Hermitage) here in 1598 in a lonely moorland area. From 1617, his son Duke Maximilian I had a palace built on its site according to the plans of Heinrich Schön the Elder. Peter Candid, who came from the Netherlands, played a major role in the decorative design of the palace rooms with stucco and frescoes. During the Second World War, almost the entire roof and several rooms of the palace building were completely destroyed; it was not until 1970 that reconstruction could begin. Today, large parts of the masonry above the cellar vaults, most of which date from the construction period, have been completely renewed, while the western vestibule and the adjoining hall wall, including their decoration, have been preserved in their original state. This also essentially applies to the stucco decoration of the former Wilhelm Chapel.

properties.name: Schloss Dachau
properties.description: Schloss Dachau steht in exponierter Lage auf dem in der Stadt gelegenen Schlossberg und geht auf eine frühmittelalterliche Burg der Grafen von Dachau zurück. Von 1546 bis 1577 wurde es unter den Herzögen Wilhelm IV. und Albrecht V. durch die Münchner Hofbaumeister Heinrich Schöttl und Wilhelm Egkl zu einer mächtigen Vierflügelanlage ausgebaut und wurde bevorzugter Landsitz des Münchner Hofes. Aus dieser Zeit stammt die prunkvolle Renaissance-Holzdecke im Festsaal, die als eine der bedeutendsten in Süddeutschland gilt. Anfang des 19. Jh. wurden drei Viertel der Schlossanlage abgebrochen; erhalten blieb nur der 1715 bis 1717 durch Joseph Effner barockisierte Festsaaltrakt. Den barocken Hofgarten erweiterte im 19. Jh. Friedrich Ludwig von Sckell um einen Englischen Landschaftsgarten; bei passendem Wetter bietet er einen wunderbaren Panoramablick bis hin zu den Alpen.

properties.name: Museum Nymphenburger Porzellan auf Schloss Nymphenburg
properties.description: Im Obergeschoss des südlichen Kavalierbaus – über dem Marstallmuseum – ist die weltweit bedeutendste Sammlung an Nymphenburger Porzellanen ausgestellt. Die Privatsammlung Bäuml wird durch Stücke aus dem Münchner Residenzmuseum ergänzt und dokumentiert nahezu lückenlos die Produktion der Nymphenburger Porzellanmanufaktur von ihrer Gründung 1747 bis in die 1950er Jahre. Prunkstücke sind die Rokokofiguren von Franz Anton Bustelli und die Porzellanplattengemälde des 19. Jh.

properties.name: Golf Club Pfaffing Wasserburger Land e.V.
properties.description:
Die großzügig angelegten 18 Spielbahnen ziehen sich auf leicht hügeligem Gelände durch teils offenes und teils bewaldetes Gelände.

An drei strategisch wichtigen Stellen greifen angelegte Teiche und Hardroughs in das Spiel ein. Bei den 67 teils nach schottischem Vorbild angelegten Pottbunkern und den bis zu 1.200 Quadratmeter großen und schnellen Grüns kommt Golffreude auf.

In Pfaffing war die Natur mehr als hilfreich. Die Spielbahnverläufe waren in den meisten Fällen natürlich vorgegeben. Die für den Pfaffinger Platz ausgearbeitete Strategieplanung war von der Maxime geprägt, den Spielern auf der gesamten Runde bei jedem Schlag, ja sogar bei jedem Putt geistig zu fordern und von ihm schnelle Entscheidungen zu verlangen.

Nicht die Länge ist ausschlaggebend, sondern Technik und Präzision. Wer den Risikoschlag wagt und er gelingt, wird mit einem Par, Birdie oder gar einem Eagle belohnt. Gelingt er nicht, hat jeder Spieler unabhängig von seiner Spielstärke, entsprechend seines Handicaps, einen sicheren Weg das Grün zu erreichen.

Der Slope von 130 kann sich sehen lassen. Der Pfaffinger neun-Loch Kurzplatz ist ein top gepflegter Par drei in ruhiger Lage. Er ist geradezu ideal um bei knapper Zeit zumindest eine Stunde dem Golfsport frönen zu können. Für die Golfanlage Pfaffing ist ein Par von 73/72,5 nötig.

Diese attraktive Lage und der Spitzenservice führt dazu, dass der Golfplatz in der Golf-Presse wie dem GOLF JOURNAL immer wieder Spitzenpositionen unter den besten Plätzen Deutschlands einnimmt. Außerdem ist der Golfclub Schloss Maxlrain e.V. Mitglied im "Leading Golf Courses of Germany" und zertifiziertes Mitglied im Programm "Golf und Natur". Damit wird der größtmögliche Naturschutz bei der Umsetzung und des Betriebs der Golfanlage gewürdigt.

properties.name: Golfclub Schloss Reichertshausen e.V.
properties.description:
Set amid the Ilm floodplains and rolling hills, the golf course offers everything that both the ambitious player and the nature lover could desire. Spanning 77 hectares, the holes are spread across the Ilmauen—with their numerous water hazards and ponds—as well as an exceptionally charming, rolling landscape.

The high proportion of unspoiled natural landscape is another distinctive feature of this scenically stunning course in the heart of the historic Holledau cultural landscape. The intensive course maintenance—including the planting of over 200 new trees and a complete bunker renovation—is also a strong reason to visit the GCR.

A special treat after completing a round: the clubhouse, newly built in 2011, complete with excellent dining and a terrace offering panoramic views. We’re already willing to make this prediction: Anyone who plays here once will come back.

properties.name: BIOTOPIA Lab
properties.description: Was sind Gespensterschrecken und wie sieht eine Seidenraupe von nahem aus? Im Botanischen Garten bietet das BIOTOPIA – Naturkundemuseum Bayern bis zur Eröffnung des neuen Museums einen Vorgeschmack auf das neue Konzept von BIOTOPIA. Besuchende erwarten spannende Erlebnisse wie eine virtuelle Flugerfahrung über Bayern mit dem VR-Vogelflugsimulator Birdly. Wechselnden Pop-Up-Ausstellungen geben Einblicke in lebensnahe Themen wie die unsichtbare Kraft der Pilze oder die Folgen des Artensterbens, und regen dazu an, gemeinsam eine lebenswerte Zukunft zu gestalten. Der Zutritt zum BIOTOPIA Lab erfolgt über den Haupteingang des Botanischen Gartens München. Der Besuch des Lab ist kostenfrei und im Eintrittspreis des Botanischen Garten mitinbegriffen.

properties.name: Marstallmuseum auf Schloss Nymphenburg
properties.description: Once the most precious horses of the Elector stood here, today the historic "Leibpferd-Stallung" of Schloss Nymphenburg Palace houses a world-famous collection of historic state carriages and sleighs, riding equipment and harnesses owned by the Wittelsbach dynasty.Highlights of the collection, which spans three centuries, are the coronation carriage of Emperor Karl VII (Nymphenburg Palace) from 1742, one of the most beautiful state carriages of the French Rococo period, and the state vehicles of Bavarian King Ludwig II. Magnificent harnesses, precious riding accessories and historical picture documents bring the courtly world of travel and representation to life.

properties.name: The Monastery in Weyarn from the viewpoint mountain
properties.description: The Monastery in Weyarn from the viewpoint mountain

properties.name: Museum Wald und Umwelt (Museum Forest and Environment)
properties.description: As a place for learning and experiencing, the museum's permanent exhibition holds a special rarity: a wooden library that is over 200 years old. This and many other exciting exhibits make it possible to experience the immense importance of the forest for our ancestors and for the future at first hand. The nature adventure trail in the adjacent outdoor area also offers an impressive view of the Ebersberg Forest and the Alpine chain. In the exhibition, the living being tree is illuminated from new perspectives and the current challenges of our time are addressed.

properties.name: Swedish Monument
properties.description: At the end of the Thirty Years' War, there was a severe clash between the Aibling citizen militia and the Swedish troops. On the fortified churchyard of the parish church, the people of Aibling tried to defend themselves until the very end. But the Swedes slaughtered the entire male population. The Swedish Monument was erected in memory of the fallen.

properties.name: Warmfreibad
properties.description:
Das Warmbad Miesbach ist seit über einem Jahrhundert ein fester Bestandteil der Stadt und zieht jährlich rund 25.000 Besucher an. Es bietet ein großzügiges Schwimmbecken, ein separates Kinderbecken mit Wasserspielgeräten und weitläufige Liegewiesen, die zum Entspannen einladen. Die familiäre Atmosphäre und die gepflegte Anlage machen den Besuch zu einem besonderen Erlebnis.

Bereits 1879 wurde im "Miesbacher Anzeiger" auf die Bedeutung eines städtischen Bades hingewiesen. 1886 gründete ein engagierter Förderverein das Bad, das bis 1936 in dessen Besitz blieb, bevor es an die Stadt überging. Heute unterstützt der Förderverein Warmbad Miesbach e.V. die Anlage weiterhin tatkräftig.

properties.name: Historische Fraunhofer-Glashütte im Kloster Benediktbeuern
properties.description: Der berühmte Optiker Joseph von Fraunhofer (1787–1826) erzielte seine bahnbrechenden Erfolge in Benediktbeuern: die Entwicklung des schlierenfreien Flintglases sowie die Entdeckung der nach ihm benannten „Fraunhoferschen Linien“, dunkle Linien im Sonnenspektrum. 1805 hatte der Fabrikant Joseph von Utzschneider im ehemaligen Kloster Benediktbeuern eine Glashütte sowie ein optisches Institut eingerichtet. Hier war Fraunhofer zwischen 1807 und 1819 tätig. In seiner ehemaligen Arbeitsstätte befindet sich heute ein Museum. Die Ausstellung in der historischen Glashütte zeigt zwei große Hafenschmelzöfen mit Rührwerk zur Glasherstellung, Schautafeln sowie Werkzeuge zur Glas- und Metallbearbeitung, optische Instrumente und vieles mehr.

properties.name: Church of St. George in Kleinpienzenau
properties.description: The branch church of St. George in Kleinpienzenau was built in 1496 as an unplastered tuff ashlar structure and later remodeled in the Rococo style. Particularly noteworthy are the rich stucco works by Johann Martin Pichler and the ceiling paintings by Johann Georg Gaill, which depict the martyrdom and glory of St. George. The high altar shows the saint as a dragon slayer, flanked by the weather saints, while the Rococo side altars and the artistically designed pulpit complete the overall impression.

properties.name: St. Vitus Branch Church in Mietraching
properties.description:
As early as the year 804, at the same time as the first documentary mention of Bad Aibling, the church was mentioned. Abbot Dobda of Chiemsee received the church as a gift from Tassilo III at that time. The church was rebuilt at the end of the 17th century and officially consecrated in 1697.

Only the presbytery from the Gothic period can still be attributed to the church's earliest days. However, following a renovation in the 1920s, Gothic paintings were discovered in the chancel.

Saint Vitus is depicted on the high altar as a martyr and is therefore the church's patron saint. On the side altars, one can see the Neo-Gothic style with depictions of the Pietà and the Holy Guardian Angel. The ceiling is adorned with images of the Holy Fourteen Helpers, and especially valuable are the stained-glass windows in the first window on the epistle side, bearing the inscription: Lienhard Seiringer, Kastner zu Aybling 1512, Magdalena Seiringerin, his wife 1512. At the end of the 19th century, the church received a new Stations of the Cross.

**Opening hours:**

Daily from approx. 09:00 to 17:00

properties.name: Schlosspark Nymphenburg (Nymphenburg Palace Gardens)
properties.description: Today, the character of the Nymphenburg Palace Park is shaped by Friedrich Ludwig Sckell's transformation in the first quarter of the 19th century into a landscape garden in the English style with natural planting, picturesque lakes and winding paths. As a reminder of the former important Baroque garden, which Elector Max Emanuel had laid out from 1701 onwards on the model of the strictly geometrical French gardens, Sckell retained the Great Parterre and the central axes such as the central canal with its concluding cascade, thus creating a charming combination of two such contrasting garden styles. The park of Schloss Nymphenburg (Nymphenburg Palace) is home to a unique gem: the "Amalienburg", a palace built from 1731 to 1739 according to designs by François Cuvilliés the Elder, which is considered one of the most precious creations of the European Rococo. Three other park castles also set architectural accents: Joseph Effner designed the Chinese-style tea house "Pagodenburg" (1716-1719), the bathing castle "Badenburg" (1718-1721) and the "Magdalenenklause", an artificial ruin (from 1725).

properties.name: Pilgrimage Church of Maria Kappel
properties.description: Die ursprünglich gotische Wallfahrtskirche Maria Kappel wurde im 18. Jahrhundert umgebaut. Stuck von Franz Xaver Schmuzer und Fresken von Franz Martin Kuen gestalteten bis 1756 das Innere der Wallfahrtskirche im Stil des Rokokos. Die Kirche birgt eine Gruftkapelle der Fugger. Die Hofmark Schmiechen im Südosten von Augsburg hatte Jakob Fugger 1506 von Kaiser Maximilian I. erworben. An die früheren Hofmarksherren erinnern das Fuggerwappen am Chorbogen und Epitaphe.

properties.name: Heimat- und Industriemuseum (Museum of local history and industry)
properties.description: Die Geschichte Kolbermoors ist untrennbar mit der Baumwollspinnerei verbunden, die 1860 hier gegründet wurde und den Beginn der Industrialisierung im Mangfalltal markiert. Nun ist sie ein Fall fürs Museum, denn 1993 wurde der Betrieb eingestellt. Neben der Geschichte der Spinnerei widmet sich das Museum aber auch dem Thema „Moor und Torf“, ebenfalls ein wichtiger Erwerbszweig der Kolbermoorer. Exponate zur Entwicklung der Stadt ergänzen den heimatkundlichen Bereich.

properties.name: Lauser Pond
properties.description:
Der Lauser Weiher liegt in der Gemeinde Feldkirchen-Westerham im Ortsteil Unterlaus und liegt ungefähr einen Kilometer südlich der Gemeinde- und Landkreisgrenze am Rand des Naturschutzgebietes Kupferbachtal.  
Der See ist von waldigen Hügeln umgeben, weshalb er bereits am späten Nachmittag im Schatten liegt. Das Fischvorkommen des Sees, der an den Kreisfischereiverein Bad Aibling verpachtet ist, beschränkt sich auf diverse Weißfischarten, Hechte, Zander, Karpfen und Schleien. Betrieb auch bei schlechtem Wetter.

properties.description: If there were also a church here, it would be “Bavaria in miniature”: maypole, little hut, viewing bench, and the inn is not far away either. It is only a few minutes’ walk up to Weyarner Lindl, where you can enjoy a 360° panorama. A 30-minute walk continues on to the Celtic rampart of Fentbach.
